summary: Add a Red Hat registry pull secret (created from a Registry Service Account's OpenShift Secret tab) to the RHDH Helm config under `upstream.backstage.image.pullSecrets` so dynamic plug-ins can pull from authenticated registries.
questions: How do I add a pull secret to the RHDH Helm chart?
Where do pullSecrets go in the Developer Hub Helm values?
RHDH can't pull images from registry.redhat.io
